Deadlines
The application portal for all degree programs opens on October 1 and closes for each program on the respective dates specified below. These deadlines refer to applications for enrollment in the fall semester of the subsequent academic year.
Graduate Application
PhD
December 1
Biology, Psychology, Chemistry
December 15
Anthropology (not accepting applications this cycle), Art & Architectural History, Economics, English, History, Media Studies, Nursing, Physics, Politics, Religious Studies, French
January 15
Astronomy, Classics, Environmental Sciences, Mathematics, Music, Philosophy, Sociology, Spanish (not accepting applications this cycle), Statistics
Master of Art
December 1
Biology
January 15
English, Linguistics, French
January 15 - May 1
The following programs accept applications through May 1, with priority review of applications and admission decisions beginning on January 15.
Anthropology, Environmental Sciences, European Studies (applications paused), History (priority review begins December 15), Linguistics, Media Studies, Middle Eastern and South Asian Languages and Cultures, Physics, Politics-Foreign Affairs and Government (priority review begins February 15), Religious Studies
Master of Fine Arts
December 15
Creative Writing
January 15
Drama (applications paused)
Master of Science
December 1
Biology
January 15
Chemistry, Environmental Sciences, Mathematics, Physics, Statistics
Graduate Application
